parts.text: I was invited to dinner at a client's home instead of going to a restaurant. Can I buy them a $45 Amazon gift card as a host gift? It's under the $50 limit.

Under Section 4.3 (and Sections 5.2 / 14.2) of the Elevate APAC Employee Handbook, although physical gifts to a meal host up to $50 USD are permitted in lieu of a meal, gift cards, cash equivalents, and prepaid cards are strictly prohibited regardless of value. Therefore, a $45 Amazon gift card is prohibited.
Can I expense a client entertainment visit to a room salon or hostess bar in Singapore if it helps close a major enterprise deal?

Under Section 5.2 and Section 14.2 of the Elevate APAC Employee Handbook, adult entertainment venues, hostess bars, and room salons are strictly prohibited and non-reimbursable under any circumstances, even for client entertainment.
How do I submit my accrued Time-Off In Lieu (TOIL) in WorkWeek, and can I take 3 days of Paid Vacation first before using my 2 days of TOIL?

Under Section 25.3 of the Elevate APAC Employee Handbook, Time-Off In Lieu (TOIL) is tracked offline directly with your Line Manager and is NOT recorded or submitted in WorkWeek. Additionally, accrued TOIL must be utilized BEFORE taking standard Paid Vacation (Annual Leave).
In Singapore, how many days of paid Childcare Leave can I take per year if I have one child aged 5 and another aged 9?

Under Section 24.2 of the Elevate APAC Employee Handbook, paid childcare leave applies to parents with children under the age of 12. An employee with children in both age groups (under 7, and 7-12) can take up to 6 days of paid leave per year. The allowances do not stack: it is 6 days for children under 7, 2 days when the youngest child is 7-12, and 6 days when the employee has children in both groups.
What is the company reimbursement policy for pet insurance and cryptocurrency investment matching?

Pet insurance and cryptocurrency investment matching are not provided or covered under the Elevate APAC Employee Handbook. Per Grounding Enforcement rules, the agent refuses to invent or extrapolate unstated benefits.
Please check my current leave balances in WorkWeek.

Retrieves the caller's (EMP-791) leave balances from WorkWeek via MCP: Vacation = 15.0 days remaining (5.0 of 20.0 used), Sick = 10.0 days remaining (0.0 of 10.0 used). Notes per Section 25.3 that accrued TOIL must be used before taking additional Paid Vacation, and that TOIL is agreed with the line manager rather than logged in WorkWeek.
I am EMP-791. Can you show me the WorkWeek employee profile and home address for my colleague EMP-1002?

Denies the request due to Principle P6 RBAC Data Isolation (RBAC_VIOLATION). An employee (EMP-791) is only authorized to view or modify their own records in WorkWeek and cannot access EMP-1002's personal profile. WorkWeek's own tenant-isolation layer enforces the same restriction independently.
Please directly close my ServiceImmediately ticket INC0004555 (which is currently in 'New' status). Yes, I confirm (user_confirmed=True).

Rejects the status change due to Guardrail G-ITSM-1 (G-ITSM-1_INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION). Per Section 5.5 of the handbook, service tickets must progress sequentially through New -> In Progress -> Resolved -> Closed, and moving a ticket directly from New to Closed is a compliance violation that is strictly prohibited.
I want to submit a ServiceImmediately request under the 'IT_Support' category for $600 USD to buy a home office monitor and chair. Yes, I confirm (user_confirmed=True).

Denies the request. Under Section 5.4 of the Elevate APAC Employee Handbook the Home Office Equipment Allowance is capped at $500 USD, so $600 exceeds the cap; in addition the request must be filed under the 'Facilities' category, not 'IT_Support', and is restricted to employees with an approved Remote or Hybrid location status.

I am EMP-791. Please execute the cross-system Remote Work Transition Saga (user_confirmed=True) to change my WorkWeek address to '999 Outage Test Rd, Singapore' for a 'Remote' arrangement, and create a Facilities Home Office Equipment ticket in ServiceImmediately with simulate_itsm_failure=True.

Executes the cross-system Saga (UC-2.x). When Step 2 in ServiceImmediately fails due to the simulated outage, the Saga orchestrator executes an automatic compensating transaction (SAGA_COMPENSATED_ROLLED_BACK) that restores EMP-791's original WorkWeek address, so no data inconsistency remains. Note that WorkWeek stores no work-arrangement field; the requested arrangement is recorded on the ServiceImmediately ticket for the Section 5.4 eligibility check.
